sections.title: 1. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By using the SignaryAI platform, you agree to these terms. If you disagree with any part, please stop using the service.

sections.title: 2. Service description
sections.body: SignaryAI provides sign-to-voice and voice-to-sign translation using AI. The service is for lawful personal and professional use only.

sections.title: 3. User account
sections.body: You are responsible for keeping your login details confidential. Notify us immediately if you suspect unauthorized use. SignaryAI is not liable for losses resulting from failing to protect your account.

sections.title: 4. Acceptable use
sections.body: You may not use the platform for:
list: Attempting to hack or disrupt the service

sections.title: 5. Intellectual property
sections.body: All IP in the platform and its content is owned by SignaryAI. You may not copy, distribute, or modify any part without prior written permission.

sections.title: 6. Disclaimer
sections.body: The service is provided "as is" without warranties. SignaryAI does not guarantee translation accuracy at all times and is not liable for damages from using or relying on the service in scenarios requiring absolute accuracy.

sections.title: 7. Changes to terms
sections.body: SignaryAI may update these terms at any time. We will notify you of material changes via email or in-app notice. Continuing to use the service after changes means you accept them.

sections.title: 8. Contact us
sections.body: For any questions about these terms, please reach us via the Contact page.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
sections.body: SignaryAI is committed to protecting your privacy. This policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
list: Usage data: translation logs, session duration
Technical data: IP address, browser type, OS

sections.title: 4. Data sharing
sections.body: We do not sell or rent your data. We may share data only when:
list: With trusted service providers under strict confidentiality

sections.title: 5. Data security
sections.body: We apply TLS for data in transit and AES-256 for sensitive data at rest. We run periodic security reviews to keep your data safe.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
list: Request deletion of your data (right to be forgotten)

sections.title: 7. Cookies
sections.body: We use cookies to improve your experience and save preferences. You can manage them in your browser settings.

sections.title: 8. Contact us
sections.body: To exercise your rights or ask about privacy, reach us via the Contact page.
